Name: Enchanted Galaxy and Infinity Weapons
Author: namelessto
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Enchanted Galaxy and Infinity Weapons[/b][/size]
[i]Galaxy and Infinity weapons drop from special barrels in the Mines and Skull Cavern, sometimes with innate enchantments and a forge enchantment.[/i][/center]

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]
Special barrels appear in the Mines and Skull Cavern, giving ore, gems, or geodes when broken open. Once you've unlocked a Galaxy or Infinity weapon, those same barrels can also drop a Galaxy or Infinity weapon, possibly with enchantments and/or innate enchantments.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Special barrels spawn on mine floors. Unlocking a Galaxy or Infinity weapon lets those barrels start dropping Galaxy or Infinity weapons too.[/*]
[*]Up to 5 weapons can drop per day (configurable).[/*]
[*]Drop chance starts at 60% and scales up to 90% at floor 120.[/*]
[*]Dropped weapons have a 50% chance for innate enchantments, 15% for a regular enchantment, and 10% for a gem enchantment.[/*]
[*]Barrels also drop items from a configurable loot pool by default: geodes, ores, bars, and gems.[/*]
[*]Automatically detects and supports weapons added by other mods.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to Use[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Enter a mine floor. A corner message will appear if a barrel is present on that floor.[/*]
[*]Break the barrel for ore, gems, or geodes.[/*]
[*]Once you've obtained a Galaxy Sword or any Infinity weapon, the same barrels can also drop a Galaxy or Infinity weapon.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Drop Settings[/b][/size]
[spoiler][b]Spawn Chance[/b]
[list]
[*]Drop chance starts at 60% and increases 5% every 20 floors, reaching roughly 90% by floor 120.[/*]
[*]Up to 5 weapon drops per day by default. The daily limit can be raised, lowered, or turned off entirely.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Spawn Locations[/b]
[list]
[*]Barrels can appear in the Lower Mines, Mid Mines, Upper Mines, Dangerous Mines, and Skull Cavern, each toggled independently.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Weapon Pool[/b][/size]
[spoiler][list]
[*]Six Galaxy/Infinity weapons: Galaxy Sword, Galaxy Dagger, Galaxy Hammer, Infinity Sword, Infinity Dagger, Infinity Hammer.[/*]
[*]Each of these six can be toggled on or off individually.[/*]
[*]Optionally add all vanilla weapons too.[/*]
[*]Weapons from other mods are auto-detected and toggled per mod.[/*]
[*]Barrels only start dropping Galaxy/Infinity weapons after you've unlocked the matching one, unless that gate is skipped in config.[/*]
[*]Minimum and Maximum Weapon Level filters restrict vanilla/mod weapons to a level range. Galaxy and Infinity weapons are always exempt from both caps.[/*]
[*]Drop odds across the whole pool, Galaxy/Infinity, vanilla, or modded, can be biased toward swords, daggers, or hammers.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Enchantments[/b][/size]
[spoiler][b]Chances[/b] (per dropped weapon)
[list]
[*]50% chance for one or more innate enchantments[/*]
[*]15% chance for a regular forge enchantment[/*]
[*]10% chance for a gem enchantment (1-3 applications)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Regular Enchantments[/b]
[list]
[*]Artful, Bug Killer, Crusader, Haymaker, Vampiric[/*]
[/list]
[b]Gem Enchantments[/b]
[list]
[*]Ruby, Aquamarine, Jade, Amethyst, Topaz, Emerald[/*]
[*]Application mode: Stack (one gem type multiple times), All Different (unique gems), or Random (mixed picks)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Innate Stats[/b]
[list]
[*]Defense, Weight, Slime Gatherer, Slime Slayer, Crit Power, Crit Chance, Attack, Speed[/*]
[/list]
Any of these can be individually enabled or disabled in the config.[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Custom Loot Pool[/b][/size]
[spoiler]On by default. When a weapon doesn't drop, the barrel can drop a bonus item instead (50% chance by default), stacking 1-5 at a time.

[b]Pool sources[/b]
[list]
[*]Value-based: any item priced 300g or more is included by default. Set a minimum and/or maximum sell price to change the range.[/*]
[*]Manual list: geodes (regular, frozen, magma, omni), iridium and gold ore/bars, and all six gem types are checked against the same price range as the value-based pool.[/*]
[*]Category and type filters let you exclude whole groups from the value-based pool: gems, minerals, monster loot, fish, crops, forage, rings, artifacts, quest items, and more.[/*]
[*]Quest items and the Stardrop are excluded by default, but this can be changed in config.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
All options are in [b]config.json[/b] or through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] in-game.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.10 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [i](optional, for in-game config)[/i][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download and unzip into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Works on existing saves. Barrels spawn from the start, and unlocking a Galaxy or Infinity weapon lets them begin dropping weapons too.
